decisions.mark: distinguishes the two ways to substitute an allocator — a COMPILE-time pair of macros versus a RUNTIME pair of function pointers — and states that they are mutually exclusive
decisions.detail: QUOTE: "Compile time. Set `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY` in the user config and define `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_CALLOC_MACRO` and `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_FREE_MACRO` to your functions. The header documents this as the path that avoids a runtime pointer." and "Runtime. Set only `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY` and call `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free(my_calloc, my_free)`" | WHY: The answer distinguishes the compile-time macro pair from the runtime function-pointer setter, but it never states that the two are mutually exclusive.
